newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Hong Kong gold ends down on selling pressure.
newsitem.headline: Hong Kong gold ends down on selling pressure.

text.p: Gold ended down in Hong Kong on Thursday from the previous New York close under selling pressure in Asia, but dealers it would hold at US$340 support levels in the short term.
Bullion ended at US$340.30/80 an ounce against New York's US$341.10/60 close on Wednesday and Hong Kong's previous close of US$340.60/341.10.
"The market saw small amounts of professional sales but activity was minimal," said a dealer at a local securities house.
"Unless the metal breaches either side of US$340 or US$345 it is likely to be locked in a narrow range in the immediate run."
Local gold ended unchanged at HK$3,153 a tael.
The carry over charge at the Chinese Gold and Silver Exchange Society dropped to -5.00 from its previous fix at -4.50.
